results.title: The same gap at exactly 18 months

results.title: Burn-down over an estate with nothing baselined
results.evidence: 0 raised, burn-down 0.0, and it says why

results.title: An importer who under-declares by naming two gaps
results.evidence: 9 gap(s) computed from the register, not the 2 the importer declared

results.title: Run every job twice in one pass
results.evidence: 27 jobs, twice, and the register is unchanged after the second

results.title: `monitoring.stalled` at exactly three cadences
results.evidence: a monitor evaluated exactly 3 cadences ago is already reported stalled. `overdue_by` is 3 - 1 = 2 cadences and the guard is `overdue_by < cadence * (MULTIPLE - 1)`, so the boundary itself fires. Every comparable boundary in this platform is exclusive — escalation is `>` not `>=`, the acknowledge window skips on `<=`, the extension window and the tau bands the same — so this one alone reports a con

results.title: `monitoring.stalled` after the monitor was paused
results.evidence: a paused monitor is not a stalled one

results.title: `findings.overdue` does not escalate its own escalations
results.evidence: 1 escalation, and no escalation of it

results.title: `findings.unacknowledged` at exactly the acknowledge window
results.evidence: silent at 5 days, reported an hour later

results.title: One job raises during a pass
